question: Which rite is introduced next and in which scriptures has it been indicated?
premises: The text now turns to a new rite.
This is the pavitraka rite taught by Śiva.
It has been clearly indicated in the Ratnamālā and Triśiras scriptures.
inference: The chapter transitions from mūrti-yāga to the pavitraka rite, grounding it in earlier scriptural authorities.
plain_english: Now the clear pavitraka rite taught by Śiva is explained, as it has been indicated in the revered Ratnamālā and Triśiras scriptures.
